import sys, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff, query
from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction
from geom import TAB
from pcheck import find_objects, describe

APP = Direction([0.0,0.0,-1.0], "world")
JAW = Direction([1.0,0.0,0.0], "world")
PAD_ALONG = 0.1501          # nominal jaw contact centre along approach from link6
PAD_Z_CENTER_OFF = 0.0012   # pad band centre in local Z (+1.2mm), local Z = -world Y here
GRASP_UP = 0.1423           # link6 z above nut top for pad band on nut mid
HOVER_Z = 1.000

def P(xy, z):
    return Point([float(xy[0]), float(xy[1]), float(z)], "world")

def mv(arm, xy, z, interaction="free_space", speed=None, slow=False, dry=False, tag=""):
    t = target(P(xy, z), approach=APP, jaw_line=JAW, interaction=interaction)
    kw = dict(targets={arm: t}, interaction=interaction)
    if speed: kw["speed"] = speed
    if slow: kw["slow_approaching"] = True
    if dry:
        p = tools.move_pose(dry_run=True, **kw)
        print("  dry[%s] feasible=%s code=%s" % (tag, p.feasible, p.failure_code))
        if not p.feasible:
            handoff("move not feasible: "+tag, failure_code=p.failure_code, summary=p.summary)
    r = tools.move_pose(**kw)
    print("  mv[%s] -> ok=%s status=%s code=%s err=%.4f" % (tag, r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code,
          (r.target_error_m if r.target_error_m is not None else -1)))
    return r

def pose_xy(arm):
    p = current().pose(arm)
    return np.array(p.xyz[:3], float)

def held_object(obs, arm, zlo, zhi, maxdist=0.06):
    wrist = np.array(obs.pose(arm).xyz[:3], float)
    objs = find_objects(obs, zlo, zhi, min_pix=40)
    cand = [o for o in objs if np.linalg.norm(o["axis_xy"]-wrist[:2]) < maxdist]
    cand.sort(key=lambda o: -o["n"])
    return (cand[0] if cand else None), objs

def main():
    ARM = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "right"
    COLOR = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else "blue"
    DO_PLACE = (len(sys.argv)>3 and sys.argv[3]=="place")
    obs = current()
    objs = find_objects(obs, TAB+0.0015, 0.860)
    print("initial:", describe(objs))
    nuts   = [o for o in objs if o["zmax"] < 0.800 and o["color"]==COLOR]
    screws = [o for o in objs if o["zmax"] >= 0.800 and o["color"]==COLOR]
    if not nuts or not screws:
        handoff("colour objects not found", color=COLOR, objects=describe(objs))
    nut, screw = nuts[0], screws[0]
    print("NUT", COLOR, np.round(nut["axis_xy"],4).tolist(), "top", round(nut["zmax"],4),
          "| SCREW", np.round(screw["axis_xy"],4).tolist(), "top", round(screw["zmax"],4))
    screw_axis = np.array(screw["axis_xy"], float)
    screw_top = screw["zmax"]

    # ---- 1. hover above the nut, then descend to grasp height
    zg = nut["zmax"] + GRASP_UP
    gxy = np.array([nut["axis_xy"][0], nut["axis_xy"][1]-PAD_Z_CENTER_OFF])
    mv(ARM, gxy, HOVER_Z, interaction="free_space", speed="normal", dry=True, tag="hover")
    r = mv(ARM, gxy, zg, interaction="precision", speed="normal", slow=True, tag="descend_grasp")
    if not r.ok and r.status!="reached":
        handoff("grasp descend failed", status=r.status, code=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)

    # ---- 2. close, lift
    r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "close"})
    print("  close -> ok=%s status=%s res=%s" % (r.ok, r.status, str(r["result"])[:400]))
    obs = current()
    ee = obs.robot_facts.get("end_effectors", {}).get(ARM, {})
    print("  gripper feedback:", ee.get("gripper", {}).get("feedback", {}).get("measured_opening_normalized"))
    r = mv(ARM, gxy, HOVER_Z, interaction="free_space", speed="normal", tag="lift")
    obs = current()
    h, allobjs = held_object(obs, ARM, TAB+0.030, 0.880)
    print("  after lift objects:", describe(allobjs))
    if h is None:
        handoff("nothing held after lift", arm=ARM, color=COLOR, objects=describe(allobjs))
    wrist = visible = np.array(obs.pose(ARM).xyz[:3], float)
    print("  wrist", np.round(wrist,4).tolist(), "held axis", np.round(h["axis_xy"],4).tolist(),
          "top", round(h["zmax"],4), "n", h["n"])
    off = np.array([h["axis_xy"][0]-wrist[0], h["axis_xy"][1]-wrist[1]])

        r = mv(ARM, tgt_xy, HOVER_Z, interaction="precision", speed="careful", tag="align_fix")
        obs = current(); h2, allobjs = held_object(obs, ARM, TAB+0.030, 0.880)
        if h2 is None: handoff("lost nut on fix", objects=describe(allobjs))
        err = np.array(h2["axis_xy"], float) - screw_axis
        print("  after fix err xy", np.round(err,4).tolist(), "|err|=%.4f"%np.linalg.norm(err))

    # ---- 4. descend in steps
    z_place = (TAB + 0.00945) + (wrist[2]-0.0)*0 + (h["zmax"]- (nut["zmax"]))  # placeholder
    # nut mid z relative to wrist z:
    dz_mid = h["zmax"] - wrist[2] - 0.00945    # (nut top - wrist) - half height  => nut mid - wrist
    z_wrist_final = (TAB + 0.00945) - dz_mid
    print("  dz_mid=%.4f z_wrist_final=%.4f"%(dz_mid, z_wrist_final))
    for zt, sp, it, tg in ((0.965, "normal", "precision", "descend1"), (z_wrist_final, "careful", "free_space", "descend2")):
        r = mv(ARM, tgt_xy, zt, interaction=it, speed=sp, tag=tg)
        obs = current()
        h3, allobjs = held_object(obs, ARM, 0.780, 0.880)
        print("   after %s: held=%s"%(tg, None if h3 is None else (np.round(h3["axis_xy"],4).tolist(), round(h3["zmax"],4))))
        if not r.ok:
            print("   move not reached:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)

    # ---- 5. open, retract, verify
    r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "open"})
    print("  open -> ok=%s status=%s"%(r.ok, r.status))
    mv(ARM, tgt_xy, 1.05, interaction="free_space", speed="normal", tag="retract")
    obs = current()
    objs = find_objects(obs, TAB+0.0015, 0.880)
    print("FINAL:", describe(objs))
    fn = [o for o in objs if o["color"]==COLOR and o["zmax"]<0.800]
    fs = [o for o in objs if o["color"]==COLOR and o["zmax"]>=0.800]
    if fn and fs:
        e = np.linalg.norm(np.array(fn[0]["axis_xy"],float)-np.array(fs[0]["axis_xy"],float))
        print("  VERIFY nut-screw axis error %.4f m; nut top z %.4f; screw top z %.4f"%(e, fn[0]["zmax"], fs[0]["zmax"]))
    else:
        print("  VERIFY could not find both", len(fn), len(fs))

import sys, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction
from vmeas import cam_rgbd, z_mode, z_patch, blue_mask

ARM="right"; COLOR="blue"
APP=Direction([0.0,0.0,-1.0],"world"); JAW=Direction([1.0,0.0,0.0],"world")
NUT_H=0.0190
Z_SHAFT=0.818

def P(xy,z): return Point([float(xy[0]),float(xy[1]),float(z)],"world")

def mv(arm,xy,z,tag,interaction="precision",speed=None,slow=False,dry=False):
    t=target(P(xy,z),approach=APP,jaw_line=JAW,interaction=interaction)
    kw=dict(targets={arm:t})
    if speed: kw["speed"]=speed
    if slow: kw["slow_approaching"]=True
    if dry:
        p=tools.move_pose(dry_run=True,**kw)
        print("  dry[%s] feasible=%s code=%s"%(tag,p.feasible,p.failure_code))
        if not p.feasible: handoff("infeasible "+tag,failure=p.failure_code,summary=p.summary)
    r=tools.move_pose(**kw)
    print("  mv[%s] ok=%s status=%s code=%s err=%s"%(tag,r.ok,r.status,r.failure_code,
        None if r.target_error_m is None else round(r.target_error_m,4)))
    return r

def wristxy(arm):
    return np.array(current().pose(arm).xyz[:3],float)

def wrist_view(arm):
    obs=current()
    rgb,depth,K,c2w=cam_rgbd(obs,"right_wrist")
    return obs,rgb,depth,K,c2w

def main():
    obs=current(); w0=wristxy(ARM)
    print("start wrist",np.round(w0,4).tolist())
    # --- head measurement of the screw (initial target)
    rgb,depth,K,c2w=cam_rgbd(obs,"head")
    hp=z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,0.7805,0.0012,blue_mask,min_px=60)
    hd=z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,Z_SHAFT,0.0015,blue_mask,min_px=25)
    print("head head-face",None if hp is None else np.round(hp["xy"],4).tolist(),
          "| head shaft-top",None if hd is None else np.round(hd["xy"],4).tolist())
    if hp is None: handoff("screw not measured on head")
    head_face_z=hp["z"]; tgt=np.array(hp["xy"],float)
    # --- wrist measurement of held nut -> offset
    obs,rgb,depth,K,c2w=wrist_view(ARM); wz=wristxy(ARM)
    nut_top_pred=wz[2]-0.1426
    np_=z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,nut_top_pred,0.0020,blue_mask,min_px=200)
    if np_ is None: handoff("held nut not seen in wrist view",wrist=wz.tolist())
    offset=np.array([np_["xy"][0]-wz[0],np_["xy"][1]-wz[1]])
    dz=wz[2]-np_["z"]
    print("wrist nut bore",np.round(np_.get("xy"),4).tolist(),"z",round(np_["z"],4),"n",np_["n"],
          "offset",np.round(offset,4).tolist(),"dz",round(dz,4))
    # --- hover over screw
    mv(ARM,tgt,1.020,tag="hover")
    # --- servo loop with wrist camera
    for it in range(3):
        obs,rgb,depth,K,c2w=wrist_view(ARM); wz=wristxy(ARM)
        nut=z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,wz[2]-dz,0.0020,blue_mask,min_px=200)
        sh =z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,Z_SHAFT,0.0015,blue_mask,min_px=25)
        if nut is None or sh is None:
            print("  iter%d missing nut=%s shaft=%s"%(it,nut is None,sh is None))
            if sh is None: break
        else:
            err=np.array([nut["xy"][0]-sh["xy"][0],nut["xy"][1]-sh["xy"][1]])
            print("  iter%d nut %s (z %.4f) shaft %s (z %.4f) err %s |e|=%.4f"%(
                it,np.round(nut["xy"],4).tolist(),nut["z"],np.round(sh["xy"],4).tolist(),sh["z"],
                np.round(err,4).tolist(),np.linalg.norm(err)))
            if np.linalg.norm(err)<0.0006: break
            tgt=np.array([wz[0]-err[0],wz[1]-err[1]])
            mv(ARM,tgt,1.020,tag="align%d"%it,interaction="precision",speed="careful")
    # --- descend
    z_final=head_face_z+0.0005+NUT_H+dz
    print("head_face_z=%.4f dz=%.4f -> wrist z_final=%.4f"%(head_face_z,dz,z_final))
    for zt,tag,sp in ((0.985,"descend1","normal"),(0.962,"descend2","normal"),(z_final,"descend3","careful")):
        mv(ARM,tgt,zt,tag=tag,interaction="precision",speed=sp)
    # --- open + retract + verify
    r=tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM:"open"})
    print("  open ok=%s status=%s"%(r.ok,r.status))
    mv(ARM,tgt,1.060,tag="retract",interaction="free_space",speed="normal")
    obs=current()
    rgb,depth,K,c2w=cam_rgbd(obs,"head")
    nut=z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,0.7805,0.0030,blue_mask,min_px=60)   # nut seated low?
    top=z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,Z_SHAFT,0.0015,blue_mask,min_px=15)
    print("VERIFY head: low-blue(nut?)",None if nut is None else (np.round(nut["xy"],4).tolist(),round(nut["z"],4),nut["n"]),
          "| shaft-top",None if top is None else (np.round(top["xy"],4).tolist(),round(top["z"],4),top["n"]))
    for o in z_mode(rgb,depth,K,c2w,blue_mask,min_px=60):
        print("  head blue comp:",{k:(np.round(v,4).tolist() if isinstance(v,np.ndarray) else v) for k,v in o.items()})
main()

import sys, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff, query
from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction
from vmeas import cam_rgbd, world_pts, blue_mask, pink_mask, z_patch, z_mode
from geom import TAB

NUT_H = 0.0190
Z_SHAFT = 0.8180
CAM = {"left":"left_wrist","right":"right_wrist"}

def white_mask(rgb):
    a=rgb.astype(np.float32)
    mx=a.max(-1); mn=a.min(-1)
    return (mx>150)&((mx-mn)<28)

MASKS={"blue":blue_mask,"pink":pink_mask,"white":white_mask}

def head_objects(obs):
    rgb,depth,K,c2w=cam_rgbd(obs,"head")
    Wp,ok=world_pts(depth,K,c2w)
    out=[]
    for cname,mf in MASKS.items():
        from skimage.measure import label, regionprops
        m=mf(rgb)&ok&(Wp[...,2]>TAB+0.0015)&(Wp[...,2]<0.860)&(np.abs(Wp[...,0])<0.42)&(np.abs(Wp[...,1])<0.32)
        lab=label(m,connectivity=2)
        for rp in regionprops(lab):
            if rp.area<60: continue
            reg=rp.image; sl=rp.slice
            z=Wp[...,2][sl][reg]; xy=Wp[...,:2][sl][reg]
            bins=np.arange(z.min(),z.max()+0.0005,0.0005)
            h,_=np.histogram(z,bins=bins); k=int(np.argmax(h))
            zc=(bins[k]+bins[k+1])/2
            sel=np.abs(z-zc)<0.0005
            out.append(dict(color=cname, n=int(rp.area), zmax=float(z.max()), z_top=float(zc),
                            top_xy=xy[sel].mean(0), centroid=xy.mean(0), kind="nut" if z.max()<0.800 else "screw"))
    return out

def show(objs):
    return [dict(color=o["color"],kind=o["kind"],n=o["n"],z_top=round(o["z_top"],4),
                 top_xy=np.round(o["top_xy"],4).tolist()) for o in objs]

def P(xy,z): return Point([float(xy[0]),float(xy[1]),float(z)],"world")

def mv(arm,xy,z,tag,approx,jaw,interaction="precision",speed=None,slow=False,dry=False):
    t=target(P(xy,z),approach=approx,jaw_line=jaw,interaction=interaction)
    kw=dict(targets={arm:t})
    if speed: kw["speed"]=speed
    if slow: kw["slow_approaching"]=True
    if dry:
        p=tools.move_pose(dry_run=True,**kw)
        print("  dry[%s] feasible=%s code=%s | %s"%(tag,p.feasible,p.failure_code,p.summary))
        if not p.feasible: return None,p
    r=tools.move_pose(**kw)
    print("  mv[%s] ok=%s status=%s code=%s err=%s"%(tag,r.ok,r.status,r.failure_code,
        None if r.target_error_m is None else round(r.target_error_m,4)))
    return r,None

def wrist_pose(arm): return np.array(current().pose(arm).xyz[:3],float)

def wrist_measure(arm, dz_hint=0.1429):
    obs=current(); rgb,depth,K,c2w=cam_rgbd(obs,CAM[arm]); wz=wrist_pose(arm)
    nut=z_patch(rgb,depth,K,c2w,wz[2]-dz_hint,0.0020,blue_mask if True else None,min_px=150)
    return obs,wz,rgb,depth,K,c2w,nut

def stage_grasp(arm,color,jaw):
    obs=current()
    objs=head_objects(obs)
    print("inventory:",show(objs))
    nuts=[o for o in objs if o["color"]==color and o["kind"]=="nut" and np.linalg.norm(o["top_xy"])<0.5]
    if not nuts: handoff("nut not found",color=color,objs=show(objs))
    nut=nuts[0]
    print("TARGET nut",color,np.round(nut["top_xy"],4).tolist(),"z_top",round(nut["z_top"],4))
    gxy=np.array([nut["top_xy"][0],nut["top_xy"][1]-0.0012])
    zg=nut["z_top"]+0.1429
    # reach check
    import geom
    q=geom.quat_from_approach([0,0,-1],jaw)
    rc=query("reach_check",arm=arm,poses=[[gxy[0],gxy[1],zg]+list(q),],interaction="precision")
    print("  reach grasp:",rc["results"][0].get("reachable"),rc["results"][0].get("reason"),rc["results"][0].get("joint_limit_margin_deg"))
    if not rc["results"][0].get("reachable"): handoff("grasp pose unreachable",arm=arm,xy=gxy.tolist())
    r,_=mv(arm,gxy,1.000,"hover",[0,0,-1],jaw,dry=True,speed="normal")
    if r is None: handoff("hover infeasible")
    mv(arm,gxy,zg,"descend_grasp",[0,0,-1],jaw,speed="normal",slow=True)
